Historical market selection backtest

Restaurant Expansion
Market Evidence

Three ranking rules evaluated on the same 100 largest eligible US metropolitan areas at the 2018-02-01 cutoff. The held-out outcome is industry-wide limited-service restaurant establishment net additions from 2018 to 2021.

White-space score versus observed outcome

Shortlist: Miami, Tampa, Houston, Phoenix, Riverside. The score and later observed additions are distinct quantities.

Score definition: 2016 population × national CBP restaurant density − existing CBP 2015 establishments. It estimates capacity relative to observed supply; it is not predicted profit or the 2018–2021 outcome.

Selection comparison and research boundaries

Limitations: the 2018–2021 outcome includes COVID-19 and is the only evaluation window. OMB 2017 geography is applied retrospectively. The label is industry-wide net establishment additions, not chain-specific profit, revenue, survival, or causal entry returns. Missing post-2017 CBP small cells remain unknown, not zero.
